verdict.rationale: The evidence covers MX's connectivity products, webhooks, test institutions, and dashboard tools (e.g., User lookup for a single user's connection attempts) but nothing documents a per-institution status page, outage/degradation signals, or an error-code taxonomy that distinguishes institution-side failures from integrator-side problems. This is a fair ask for an aggregation platform whose core risk is bank-side outages, so absence of evidence is 'none' rather than 'na'.
